name: Passerines in End Times
source:
Canary lives alone in the remnants of an abandoned city, years after the collapse of civilization. One stormy winter night, a nameless traveler stumbles into her humble home, looking for a place to shelter from the rain.

[From [url=https://misamxsa.itch.io/passerines-in-end-times]itch.io[/url]]
